correctness.rationale: For all 21 independent equal continuous edge priorities the first currently admissible edge is uniform, leading to a terminating exact occupied-vertex recurrence. Two independent state representations produce the same 19/330, 497/792, 1247/3960 fractions. The 234 maximal matchings are completely enumerated and the full group of 336 graph symmetries yields exactly five orbits; exact path sums give the five rational microstate weights. Three standalone programs contain and pass all asserted identities. The result makes no infinite-graph claim.

value.rationale: Heawood is the canonical smallest cubic girth-six cage. A complete exact irreversible dimer-packing law is a natural benchmark distinct from static matching enumeration. The unexpected three distinct kinetic weights among equal-size-six maximal matchings expose symmetry-sensitive deposition bias, while exact 1247/3960 perfection probability gives a concrete irreversible-versus-optimal contrast. This is substantive as a natural, complete finite classification even without downstream or asymptotic theorem.
